description: Lines like 'you're so dumb' with no specific detail
detector: reverse_test: could any character say this in any script?

description: character panics → NOTABOT exposes → they beg → NOTABOT delivers punchline. Same 4-step arc every time.
detector: structure_check: does the arc match this 4-step template exactly?

description: Last line is a summary or moral ('well that was a disaster')
detector: ending_check: does the last line summarise what happened?

description: Every line is 5-10 words lowercase. No variation in length or energy.
More than 2 characters roasting the same target in the same 5-line block
detector: code: 3+ different speakers targeting same character consecutively

description: A character explains why their own line is funny
detector: voice_critic: flag any line that explains the previous line

description: bro what / wait what / oh no / that's crazy / no way / lmaooo used as a full message
More than 3 emojis in a single message, or the same emoji 3+ times in a row
detector: code: emoji count per line and consecutive repeat check

description: Conflict energy is flat across the whole script
detector: structure_critic: check that beat 3 tension score > beat 1

description: A detail is planted but never paid off
detector: structure_critic: every plant in the beat sheet must resolve

description: Any reference to a real event, game, movie, song, or person by name
NOTABOT has the same role in 3 consecutive episodes
detector: ledger: check notabot_role for last 3 entries

description: Every message is a tidy complete quip. No burst typing, no fragments, no ignored messages.
detector: chat_realism_critic: flag if no burst pattern detected in script

description: Characters use ALL CAPS panic as the default register, not earned emphasis
